assembly_notes: Fit and inspect shell mating faces, boss pilots, and screw engagement; avoid overtightening to prevent boss damage.
Route and secure mains wiring clear of the fan, heater, and sharp edges; verify strain relief and thermal-cutout placement.
Perform electrical safety, airflow, heater-control, and thermal-cutout functional tests on each assembled unit.
Run a controlled burn-in under load and check for abnormal noise, vibration, overheating, or finish damage.
